paragraphs: Stellarware Corporation was founded in 1997 as a web design firm and now builds web systems for government and private sector organizations. Core business areas listed are project management and operation for insurance intercept, Medicaid, financial institution data match (FIDM), real property data match, new hire reporting and web design. Stellarware operates the Child Support Lien Network, hosted by the State of Rhode Island, and works with the states of Rhode Island and Texas on the Medicaid Recovery Network.

New Hire Reporting projects are managed in the District of Columbia, Georgia, Minnesota, Rhode Island, Virginia and Wisconsin, among other states. Those projects help employers work with state government through Internet based systems, including a Child Support Portal. Plug-in solutions named on the site include a Lump Sum Payment Module and electronic distribution of Income Withholding Orders.

The Child Support Lien Network has assisted 32 U.S. state agencies in collecting over $2.4 billion in past-due child support. New Hire projects processed over 17 million new hire reports in the year 2023, and the Medicaid Recovery Network has collected over $33.8 million in Medicaid costs for State government.
